# Corpus AI

Corpus AI is a DBA of Corpus Localization LLC. It sells a Google Business Profile reinstatement evidence packet. It is not a certified-translation shop and not an AI automation agency.

## Offer

- Product: GBP Reinstatement Packet
- Price: $149
- SLA: 4 business hours after complete intake
- URL: https://nshempstead1.github.io/corpus-ai/
- Cost comparison: https://nshempstead1.github.io/corpus-ai/cost.html

A local business whose Google Business Profile was suspended or failed verification must submit matching evidence through Google’s appeal tool. Since July 2026 evidence attaches directly inside the appeal form (accounts on the older flow get a separate evidence form with a 60-minute submission window). Google allows one appeal and one additional review, so the package must be complete and matching before the appeal is filed.

The packet includes a violation diagnosis, pre-appeal field edits, renamed and checked evidence (license, registration, utility bill ≤90 days, lease/tax, signage), an appeal letter under 1,000 characters, and a submission run sheet.

## What we do not do

- We do not log into the customer’s Google account.
- We do not submit the appeal.
- We do not guarantee reinstatement or rankings.
- We do not fabricate documents.
- We do not sell OpenClaw/agent install retainers or certified translations under this brand page.

## Price context (2026)

Google’s appeal is free. GBPRevive sells a $39.99 DIY recovery kit. Done-for-you shops commonly charge $349–$1,000 (Green Thumb Local, Arif Shaik $499, RZ Web Media $497, GMB Gorilla $500, Sterling Sky $800 success-fee, JCerme $1,000).
